cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'EOF'
import subprocess, sys, json
def t(txt, expect, label):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'main.py'], input=txt if isinstance(txt,bytes) else txt.encode(), capture_output=True)
    got = p.stdout.decode().strip()
    print(('OK  ' if got==expect else 'FAIL'), label, '->', got[:60], 'expected', expect)
base = json.dumps({"version":1,"schema":[{"name":"a","type":"FLAG"}],"window":1,"atoms":[],
  "policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[]})
# dup key via unicode escape
t('{"version":1,"schema":[],"\\u0076ersion":2}', '{"error":"E_JSON"}', 'dup via escape')
# string with brackets/escapes
o = json.loads(base); o["train"] = []
s = '{"version":1,"schema":[{"name":"a","type":"FLAG"}],"window":1,"atoms":[],"note":"[][]{} \\" \\\\ ok","policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[]}'
t(s, '{"error":"E_SCHEMA"}', 'brackets in string (schema empty -> E_SCHEMA)')
# 64-deep nested arrays inside a valid request? not possible; test depth in ignored position
t('[' * 64 + ']' * 64, '{"error":"E_SCHEMA"}', 'depth64 root array')
t('[' * 65 + ']' * 65, '{"error":"E_JSON"}', 'depth65 root array')
t('{"a":' * 64 + '1' + '}' * 64, '{"error":"E_SCHEMA"}', 'depth64 obj')
t('{"a":' * 65 + '1' + '}' * 65, '{"error":"E_JSON"}', 'depth65 obj')
# nested 63 deep inside root object = depth 64 total
t('{"version":' + '['*63 + ']'*63 + ',' + base[1:], '{"error":"E_JSON"}', 'malformed')
# huge whitespace
t(base + ' '*100000, json.dumps({"version":1,"classes":[],"queries":[]},separators=(',',':')), 'trailing whitespace ok')
t('  \n\t' + base, json.dumps({"version":1,"classes":[],"queries":[]},separators=(',',':')), 'leading whitespace ok')
# unescaped control char
t('{"version":1,"schema":[],"a\x01b":2}', '{"error":"E_JSON"}', 'raw control char')
# lone surrogate escape
t('{"version":1,"\\ud800":1}', '{"error":"E_SCHEMA"}', 'lone surrogate key -> E_SCHEMA')
# invalid \u
t('{"version":"\\uZZZZ"}', '{"error":"E_JSON"}', 'bad unicode escape')
EOF
